Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Al and Zr centers each surrounded by eight Fe neighbors, while Fe centers have eight neighbors comprising four Al and four Zr, all at 2.6649 Å with a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement. The periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions across all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing among Fe-centered 8-vertex polyhedra, and corner and face sharing between Al- and Zr-centered polyhedra.
